title: PlugShare Favorite Charger Rating Drop
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Rivian telemetry, ChargePoint session exports, PlugShare trip logs, Smartcar, and OBD-II / home-charger data via APIs, CSV exports, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plugshare:checkin
| stats latest(score) as current_score, earliest(score) as first_score, count as visits by station_name
| eval score_delta=round(current_score-first_score,1)
| where visits>=3 AND score_delta<-0.5
| sort score_delta
description: Uses PlugShare station check-ins telemetry to monitor how favorite charging stops are trending over repeated visits in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for stations whose real-world reliability has declined, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest PlugShare station check-ins data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Ranked table of charger score change over time.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how favorite charging stops are trending over repeated visits so you can spot stations whose real-world reliability has declined before it becomes annoying.
